title: Impulse-Buy Detector
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| eventstats avg(amount) as avg_amt, stdev(amount) as sd by category
| eval impulse=if(amount>avg_amt+2*sd AND flagged="unplanned",1,0)
| where impulse=1
| table _time merchant amount category
description: Flags unusually large, unplanned purchases that stand out from your normal spending in each category.
value: Catching impulse buys as they happen builds awareness and, over time, a pause before the next one.
implementation: Ingest categorised transactions into `index=personal`; alert on large unplanned outliers.
grandmaExplanation: It spots unusually big, unplanned purchases, helping you notice impulse buys and think twice next time.
